title: rclone mounts
noMountsHint: Mount a remote with rclone mount (or rclone rcd) and it shows up here.
collectorFailed: Couldn't read mount stats (needs bash, jq, curl and findmnt)
outOfSpace: Cache is out of disk space
sharedProcess: Speeds and CPU are for the whole rclone rcd process
statsOff: Stats API is off for this mount
statsOffHint: Add --rc --rc-no-auth --rc-addr unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/rclone.sock to its rclone command to see cache and upload stats.
statsAuth: Stats API needs a password, so cache stats aren't shown
noProcess: No rclone process is serving this mount
noProcessHint: It may be a stale mount. Unmount it with: fusermount3 -u <mount point>
tooltip: rclone: cache %1 MB/s, network %2 MB/s, %3 uploading
